article.title: MSQ在亞洲推出Signal，以AI答案訊號連接內容製作
article.summary: MSQ在新加坡介紹MSQ Signal，把品牌、社群、搜尋及AI答案訊號帶進內容規劃與製作。
highlights: 服務以TikTok及電商為起點，可按品牌需要加入付費媒體、創作者及零售媒體。
據現場報道，MSQ示範重複執行購物提示詞，觀察品牌在AI答案的推薦佔比。
article.why: AI答案成為內容迭代的觀察訊號，區域團隊可先確定哪些購物問題值得納入固定追蹤，再決定要改哪些內容。
article.next_step: 挑選同一市場、語言及品類的購物問題，保留每次答案與內容變更日期，檢查是否出現可重複觀察的差異。
article.detail: Branding in Asia引述MSQ管理層，介紹從發現訊號、發展創意到推出內容及觀察反應的工作循環。MSQ把這套流程建於亞洲社群和電商環境，並在活動示範AI推薦佔比的追蹤。團隊可以先固定一批問題及觀察條件，再把答案變化與內容更新並列，作為後續研究的起點。
article.title_en: MSQ launches Signal in Asia to connect AI answer signals with content
article.summary_en: MSQ introduced MSQ Signal in Singapore to bring brand, social, search and AI answer signals into content planning and production.
highlights_en: It starts with TikTok and commerce and can add paid media, creators and retail media.
Event reporting describes repeated shopper prompts used to track a brand's share of recommendations in AI answers.
article.why_en: Regional teams can choose which shopping questions merit consistent tracking before deciding what content to change.
article.next_step_en: Fix a market, language and product category for a prompt set and retain answers alongside content-change dates.
article.detail_en: Branding in Asia quotes MSQ executives on a cycle from signal discovery to creative development, content release and observation. The Asia-built workflow included a demonstration of AI recommendation tracking. Teams can hold questions and observation conditions steady and compare answer changes with content updates as a starting point for further research.
